column6: Dated founder essay published 2026-07-26 on the live journal; sections index also lists stories through 2026-08-02.

TechBuzz 2026-07-10 covers the 2026-06-29 state quantum roundtable where co-founder Sumit Parashar attended for UtahQuantum.org and offered the site to the state initiative; earlier independent launch coverage is 2025-11-26.
Deseret News reports Ward 250 reached zero-power fueled criticality at Orangeville on 2026-06-18 under the DOE Reactor Pilot Program.
Company PR dated 2026-05-19 announces W-6 capsule reentry at Koonibba, Australia, the second Varda reentry of 2026; work continues under the original name.
Deseret News 2026-04-28 reports from Vector's Bluffdale factory with photos dated 2026-04-24 of Hammer drone testing and assembly; ~100 employees.
NRG Q2 2026 earnings release dated 2026-08-04 reports Vivint Smart Home Adjusted EBITDA of $301M for the quarter on higher new customer adds; work continues under NRG.
WhatTheyThink 2026-04-16 reports Vuely demonstrating AI mockup-and-proposal software in the Next Gen Tech Zone at ISA Sign Expo in Orlando (April 8-10, 2026).
App Store listing for Wagevo Inc. shows version 1.0.15 dated Jun 13 (current-year display as of 2026-08-13); live employee app from a Provo fintech. LinkedIn hiring was not used as a signal.
Army STTR Phase II W15QKN-24-C-0039 awarded 2024 (start 2024-07-11, scheduled end 2026-06-30); no website, no 2025-2026 news, filings, or dissolution found after the award record.
Company PR dated 2026-07-15 announces a live Port of Los Angeles deployment: 12 wireless pads charging 10 RIDE electric yard tractors with Ports America.
Louisiana DOTD contract 4400033472 for Wavetronix radar detection systems is effective 2025-09-05 through 2026-09-04; Springville vendor of record with current sensor SKUs.
Form 10-Q for the quarter ended 2026-06-30, signed 2026-08-06, reports ongoing SaaS operations from Lehi HQ.
Inside Higher Ed 2026-07-14 interviews President Scott Pulsipher at a new Washington, D.C. regional-office ribbon cutting; WGU still enrolling at national scale.
Company careers page for Ogden CNC machinist openings last updated 2026-04-02; press-release index also lists 2026-01-21 and 2026-01-23 items. Ogden plant work continues.

Deseret News 1994-06-27 reports Novell completed the acquisition of Orem-based WordPerfect Corp.; the Utah company's independent work ended. Corel still sells a WordPerfect Office 2021 SKU, last major version 2021.
Adobe Workfront Q4 2026 release notes (last update 2026-08-13) list monthly 26.8 fast-release features shipping 2026-08-13; product continues under Adobe.

Last independent coverage is Digital Trends 2015-11-30 on the Xandem Home Indiegogo; NSF SBIRs are older. Homepage loads with no dated content (copyright 2025 only); no 2024-2026 news, jobs, filings, or dissolution found.
YESCO project page timestamped 2025-11-13 documents fabrication of SLC Life on State 2025 Neon public-art signs; Salt Lake City Public Art Program page corroborates YESCO neon artists.
Company site dated 2026-08-12 publishes Heights case studies on in-email reviews and upsells; a 2026-07-22 YOCTO case study is also posted. YC jobs board is undated and was not used as the signal.
